tools.name: search_esim_plans
tools.description: Use this when the user is travelling abroad and wants mobile data, an eSIM, a travel SIM, or to avoid roaming charges. Finds eSIM plans in the OsmO catalogue that cover the whole trip, including multi-country trips, and ranks them by the published rule: fit first, then total price. Trip length is re

tools.name: get_esim_plan
tools.description: Use this when the user asks about one specific plan returned by search_esim_plans: networks, 5G, ID check, when validity starts, top-ups, provider notes. Hotspot and speed limits are not in our data.

tools.name: compare_esim_plans
tools.description: Use this when the user wants two to four specific eSIM plans side by side.

tools.name: check_esim_device
tools.description: Use this when the user asks whether their phone, tablet or watch supports eSIM. Answers from a maintained list of manufacturer-published specs; returns 'unknown' with self-check steps for models not listed.

tools.name: estimate_trip_data
tools.description: Use this when the user is unsure how much mobile data they need for a trip. Returns an estimate with its assumptions and sources.

tools.name: get_destination_guide
tools.description: Use this when the user asks what to know about mobile data in one country: networks, 5G listed by plans, ID checks, typical plan prices, and researched local rules. Also accepts 'at sea' for cruises.

tools.name: get_esim_setup_steps
tools.description: Use this when the user needs to install, activate, top up or fix a travel eSIM on iPhone or Android, for example no internet after landing. Gives general phone steps and provider top-up steps where we have them; not provider account support.

tools.name: compare_roaming_vs_esim
tools.description: Use this when the user asks whether a travel eSIM is cheaper or better than their own mobile carrier's international roaming pass or plan for a trip to one destination, or about local SIM cards. Compares the carrier's published pass price with the eSIM plans in the OsmO catalogue. For multi-country

tools.name: get_keep_your_number_guide
tools.description: Use this when the user asks whether they keep their phone number, WhatsApp, iMessage or bank text codes while using a travel eSIM, or how to set up two SIMs so they aren't charged for roaming data.

tools.name: get_before_you_fly_checklist
tools.description: Use this when the user asks what to do before travelling so they have mobile data on arrival.

tools.name: show_esim_plans
tools.description: Shows eSIM plan options as interactive cards. Takes the same trip inputs as search_esim_plans plus the optionIds to show (a subset of its results; the order is always the published ranking).

tools.name: show_esim_plan
tools.description: Shows one eSIM plan as an interactive card. Takes a planId from search_esim_plans.

tools.name: show_esim_comparison
tools.description: Shows two to four eSIM plans side by side as an interactive card. Takes planIds from search_esim_plans.

tools.name: show_device_check
tools.description: Shows whether a phone supports eSIM as an interactive card.

tools.name: show_data_estimate
tools.description: Shows a trip data estimate as an interactive card.

tools.name: show_roaming_comparison
tools.description: Shows a carrier roaming pass next to the best eSIM option as an interactive card.

tools.name: show_keep_your_number
tools.description: Shows what keeps working on your home number while using a travel eSIM, as an interactive card.

tools.name: show_before_you_fly
tools.description: Shows the before-you-fly checklist as an interactive card.

tools.name: show_destination_snapshot
tools.description: Shows a compact mobile-data snapshot of one destination as an interactive card.
